description: Building blocks for tidy, accessible forms: label, control, helper text and error message.
anatomy: Parts that can be combined to fit the form.

choiceCard.title: Choice Card
choiceCard.description: A FieldLabel that wraps a Field becomes a clickable card that turns green when selected.

checkboxGroup.title: Checkbox Group
checkboxGroup.description: FieldSet + FieldLegend to group several checkboxes.

horizontal.title: Horizontal
horizontal.description: Label and description next to the control, good for switches.

parts.fieldGroup: Stacks several Fields with consistent spacing.
parts.field: One field: label + control + helper text.
parts.fieldContent: Wraps label and description next to a checkbox/radio/switch.
parts.fieldLabel: Field label. When it wraps a Field, it becomes a choice card.
parts.fieldTitle: A plain text title (not linked to a control).
parts.fieldSeparator: A divider line, optionally with text in the middle (e.g. "or").

props.orientation: Label position: above (vertical), beside (horizontal), or depending on width (responsive).
props.invalid: Marks the field as having an error.
props.disabled: Marks the field as disabled (the label turns grey too).
props.errors: List of errors (e.g. from react-hook-form/zod). One error shows as text, several as a list.
